title: Keep Windows ARM64 Startup process containment reliable when PowerShell initialization is slow.
changes: Extend the bounded Windows PowerShell 5.1 Job Object helper startup handshake to 45 seconds, distinguishing initialization delays from child-creation delays.
Preserve atomic child assignment, fail-closed ownership and the requirement to confirm an empty process group before acknowledging shutdown.
Cover a deterministic helper start delayed beyond the previous 15-second limit, align native test budgets with constrained ARM64 machines and serialize lifecycle checks in Windows CI.
Retain the 0.2.223 Windows installer rollout-pause protection; migration of existing legacy Scheduled Tasks remains separate work.
